title: Your sky map
lead: Real planetary positions for your birth date, time, and place — explained in everyday language.
formTitle: First, let’s locate the moment of birth
formText: Place is not just a label: it supplies coordinates, historical time zone, horizon, Ascendant, and houses.
timeKnowledge: How accurately do you know the time?

timeModes.unknown: I do not know the time

exactHelp: Enter the hour and minute from records or family memory.
approxHelp: We compare the beginning, middle, and end and show only stable conclusions.
unknownHelp: We show the planets across the day, without inventing an Ascendant or houses.
placeHelp: Choose a city from the list — free text alone cannot support the calculation.
placeNotSelected: No city has been selected from the list.
noPlaces: No matches. Try adding a country or region.
searchError: Search is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
privacy: Your date, time, and result stay on this device. Only the search phrase is sent when you look up a city.
accuracyTitle: The result depends on what you know
exactAccuracy: Full chart: precise Ascendant, houses, and planetary positions.
rangeAccuracy: Time range: possible alternatives are shown separately from stable results.
dateAccuracy: No time: planets and stable signs, but no Ascendant or houses.

errors.time: Enter an exact time or choose a broad period.
errors.place: Search for and select your birthplace.
errors.timezone: That local time did not exist because the clocks changed. Please check it.
errors.calculation: The chart could not be calculated. Check the details and try again.
errors.coordinates: The time zone for this point could not be determined.

resultLead: Planetary positions were calculated for {place}. The essentials come first, followed by details.
bigIntro: The Sun describes core self-expression, the Moon emotional reactions, and the Ascendant your first impression and way of entering new situations.
ascRangeText: The Ascendant changes inside this time range. We show the possible signs and do not present houses as exact.
ascUnknownText: Without birth time the horizon is unknown, so the Ascendant cannot be calculated.
timeSensitive: The sign changes within the selected range; the possible alternatives are shown.
planetsIntro: Each planet represents a different part of life. Its sign describes the style in which that part tends to operate.

planetRoles.Sun: Shows where it matters to feel authentic and express personal strengths visibly.
planetRoles.Moon: Describes instinctive emotional responses, safety needs, and ways of recovering energy.
planetRoles.Mercury: Relates to thinking, speech, learning, and gathering information.
planetRoles.Venus: Shows taste, affection, closeness, pleasure, and personal values.
planetRoles.Mars: Describes action, boundaries, drive, and the expression of anger.
planetRoles.Jupiter: Shows how opportunities expand, confidence grows, and meaning is sought.
planetRoles.Saturn: Relates to discipline, responsibility, limits, and skills built slowly.
planetRoles.Uranus: Shows the need for freedom, change, unusual solutions, and new rules.
planetRoles.Neptune: Relates to imagination, empathy, ideals, and places where enchantment or confusion can arise.
planetRoles.Pluto: Shows themes of deep change, power, control, and letting go of the old.

signStyles.aries: It works through directness, a quick start, and readiness to go first.
signStyles.taurus: It works through stability, practicality, sensory comfort, and a personal pace.
signStyles.gemini: It works through curiosity, conversation, rapid information exchange, and changing interests.
signStyles.cancer: It works through care, memory, emotional sensitivity, and protection of close people.
signStyles.leo: It works through visibility, creative courage, generosity, and acting from the heart.
signStyles.virgo: It works through precision, usefulness, attention to detail, and improving a working system.
signStyles.libra: It works through balance, cooperation, taste, and consideration of another viewpoint.
signStyles.scorpio: It works through depth, inner focus, strong bonds, and a need to reach the core.
signStyles.sagittarius: It works through freedom, a broad view, humor, learning, and new horizons.
signStyles.capricorn: It works through responsibility, endurance, long goals, and building results step by step.
signStyles.aquarius: It works through independence, unconventional thinking, future ideas, and community.
signStyles.pisces: It works through imagination, empathy, intuitive perception, and softer boundaries.

aspectsIntro: An aspect shows whether two parts of the personality cooperate easily or need conscious balance.

aspectTexts.conjunction: The two themes switch on together and amplify one another. Learn to use them as one tool.
aspectTexts.sextile: There is an accessible opportunity for cooperation, but it opens through your initiative.
aspectTexts.square: The themes pull in different directions. The tension can become a powerful motor when given a practical outlet.
aspectTexts.trine: The themes support each other naturally. This resource can be easy to overlook because it feels normal.
aspectTexts.opposition: Balance is needed between two poles. Choosing only one often brings the other back through people or circumstances.

noStableAspects: No major aspects stayed stable across the selected range. This does not mean the chart has no aspects.
housesIntro: We use Whole Sign houses: the Ascendant sign becomes the first house, and the rest follow in order.
housesUnknown: Without birth time the horizon cannot be reconstructed.
housesRange: The Ascendant sign changes within the selected period, so houses would be too uncertain.
methodText: Local time was converted to UTC using {timezone}. Location coordinates: {latitude}, {longitude}.
houseMethod: Planets use geocentric tropical longitudes. Houses use the Whole Sign system; the method is named because different schools use different systems.
engineNote: Astronomical positions are calculated by Astronomy Engine 2.1.19 (MIT). Place search supplies coordinates and time zone; the chart itself is calculated on your device.
disclaimer: Planetary positions are mathematical calculations; astrological interpretation is esoteric. It is not scientific diagnosis or a guarantee of events.
mapHelp: Tap your birthplace. You can pan and zoom. Use current location only if you were born there.
locationDenied: Location was not available. Allow access or place the point manually.
